From: Aisha Thompson <opslead@starlift.io>
To: support@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.hart@starlift.io, legal@starlift.io
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spike 10/05-10/06 — request for remediation credit + contract change

Hi Redwood team,

We experienced a sustained latency increase across our inference calls during the 10/05 22:00 UTC -> 10/06 04:00 UTC window. Customer-facing models saw tail latency climb to 1.6s p95 (baseline ~0.45s). This caused a measurable uptick in timeouts and retry traffic for our checkout microflow.

We've pulled logs and a timeline (attached). We'd like to start a conversation about: 1) a remediation credit to offset customer impact for that billing period, and 2) a small contractual amendment that adds an explicit escalation path for cross-region failover in future windows.

Proposed by Starlift: a one-time credit equivalent to 2 months of usage for impacted routes, or a $35k credit — whichever is lower. We're open to alternatives and want to avoid disruption while legal reviews the amendment.

Can we get an internal point of contact for exec-level approval? We need a decision this week to communicate to our board.

Thanks,
Aisha Thompson
Head of Platform Engineering
Starlift

[Attachment: starlift-incident-timeline.pdf (PDF)]
